svg.title: Givens and Householder QR of a sparse matrix
svg.desc: The same 7 by 4 sparse matrix is reduced to triangular form by Givens rotations, one entry at a time, and by Householder reflectors, one column at a time. Blue cells are original nonzeros, orange cells are fill, and the counters show rotations or reflectors, operations and fill.
svg.text: Givens: one entry at a time
Householder: one column at a time

g.text: reflect 7 rows: zero column 1 below the diagonal
reflect 6 rows: zero column 2 below the diagonal
reflect 5 rows: zero column 3 below the diagonal
reflect 4 rows: zero column 4 below the diagonal

svg.text: operations: multiplies and adds on nonzero columns only (6 per rotated column pair, about 4 per reflected entry)
Both end with the same R: its pattern is that of the Cholesky factor of AᵀA.
